ext_name.description: Extension name (manifest), %EXT_NAME% is replaced at build time (dev/prod). Max 75 characters

ext_description.message: Improve your Odoo Journey! Makes your Odoo experience more enjoyable and productive by adding some cool features and effects.
ext_description.description: Extension description (manifest, Chrome Web Store). Max 132 characters

command_enableDisable.message: Enable or Disable extension features on the current origin

badge_off.description: Toolbar badge when Joorney is disabled on the current origin. Max ~4 characters

language_description.message: Choose the language used by Joorney.

language_mode_system.description: Language mode option: follow the browser language

language_mode_odoo.description: Language mode option: follow the language of the Odoo user

language_mode_static.description: Language mode option: always use the language picked in the next select

language_hint.message: Reload Odoo tabs to apply the change. The extension name and description always follow the browser language.
language_hint.description: Preferences page: hint under the language selects

common_default.description: Default option of a select (popup, Awesome Loading image)

popup_options.description: Popup: tooltip of the button opening the options page

popup_invalidWebsite.message: This website is not compatible with Joorney extension
popup_invalidWebsite.description: Popup: shown on non-web pages (chrome://, file://...)

popup_featureTitle.description: Popup: tooltip of a feature toggle (global state)

popup_featureOriginTitle.description: Popup: tooltip of a feature toggle for the current origin

popup_originState.description: Popup: label before the current origin URL

popup_saveOrigin.description: Popup: button saving the current origin

popup_saveOriginConfiguration.description: Popup: tooltip of the button saving the origin configuration

popup_saveReload.description: Popup: button saving the origin configuration and reloading the tab

themeSwitch_mode_system.description: Theme Switch mode: follow the system theme

themeSwitch_mode_location.description: Theme Switch mode: dark between sunset and sunrise at the configured location

themeSwitch_mode_time.message: Dark mode based on configured time
themeSwitch_mode_time.description: Theme Switch mode: dark between the configured hours

unfocusApp_popup_reorder.description: Popup: tooltip of the Unfocus App reorder switch

unfocusApp_popup_share.message: Enable unfocus app configuration share between hosts
unfocusApp_popup_share.description: Popup: tooltip of the Unfocus App switch sharing the configuration between hosts

pinMessage_popup_selfAuthor.message: Manage pin for current user messages only?
pinMessage_popup_selfAuthor.description: Popup: tooltip of the Pin Message switch limiting pins to the current user messages

pinMessage_popup_defaultShown.message: Show pinned message section on load?
pinMessage_popup_defaultShown.description: Popup: tooltip of the Pin Message switch opening the pinned section on load

contextMenu_openOptions.description: Right-click menu: open the options page

contextMenu_clearCache.description: Right-click menu: clear the Joorney cache of the current host

contextMenu_unknownItem.description: Right-click menu: fallback title of an item without title

omnibox_disabled.message: The functionality to open a runbot from URL is currently disabled. Open options to enable "[Runbot] Auto Open"!
omnibox_disabled.description: Address bar default suggestion when [Runbot] Auto Open is disabled. XML: escape & and <

omnibox_openInput.description: Address bar default suggestion. XML: keep %s (user input), <match> and <dim> markup

omnibox_openRunbotVersion.description: Address bar suggestion opening runbot for an Odoo version

autoOpenRunbot_menu_openWithVersion.description: Right-click menu on runbot: %version% is replaced by the Odoo version
